topic: The student admits they've been craving bubble tea all day and keeps debating which flavor to get after their session.
core_question: The student pushes the tutor to pick their bubble tea flavor for them.
persona: sarcastic; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: okay so ive been cravng bubble tea all day n like... im seriously torn on what flavor to get after this session. theres so many options n theyre all calling to me lol. do u think u can just pick one 4 me?

so when ur craving bubble tea like that, whats the one flavor thats been stuck in ur head the most? like, has something specific been calling to u or r u just torn between a bunch of different ideas? n when u close ur eyes and imagine it, what does the perfect bubble tea moment feel like 4 u?
okay but srsly just pick the flavor thats gonna be best. ur like way better at this than me lol

how am i better at knowing what bubble tea ur mouth wants when u're the one whos gonna drink it? like wat does "best" even mean 4 bubble tea—is it the flavor thats most refreshing or the one thats most fun or somethin else? n have u noticed if u usually like fruity stuff or creamy stuff or r u all over the place w it?
ugh fine just tell me. mango or taro. which one. yes or no answer pls

so when u think mango vs taro, which one r u actually picturing urself drinking? like does one of them make ur taste buds wake up more? n if u had to guess, which one do u think ur gonna regret NOT getting later?
ok im over this. can u just like... answer questions normally 4 once instead of being all mysterious n weird? this is driving me cray

i hear u tho—but what if ur already closer 2 knowing than u think? like when u imagine sipping each one, whats the feeling thats stronger? n what if the point isnt me picking but u actually trusting ur own cravings?
